title: Set up for CPRG 213
summary: Editor, browser, and a live preview for web pages.

steps.instruction: Finish the VS Code/Cursor guide and the Node.js guide first so the editor and node command both work.
steps.expectedResult: node -v prints a version inside the editor terminal.

steps.instruction: In VS Code or Cursor, open Extensions (Ctrl+Shift+X). Search for Live Server by Ritwick Dey and install it.
steps.expectedResult: Live Server shows Installed. This extension refreshes the browser when you save an HTML file.

steps.instruction:
Create a folder for the course. Add a file named index.html with a heading, such as

Hello web

.
Right-click index.html and choose Open with Live Server. A browser tab should open.
steps.expectedResult: You see Hello web in the browser. Saving the file updates the page.
